text:
Maya (CS): FYI - Seeing a spike of failed EU onboarding attempts starting ~09:05 UTC. Customers hitting webhook auth/502 in console. I need a short technical blurb + mitigation bullet points for customer comms. @Ravi can you triage? @Priya please prepare ops mitigations.

Ravi (Eng): Quick triage: connector cert expired on EU onboarding cluster, renewal cron didn't run due to a recent config change. Webhooks were rejected at TLS handshake, causing 401/502s.

Priya (Ops): I'm flipping a temporary ingress bypass to allow retries while Ravi rotates certs. Also opening an infra incident and tagging on-call. Will enable replay window in the ingestion queue.

Liam (CS): Drafting a customer-facing note. Need a one-sentence RCA we can paste into the message and a clear "no action required" line if applicable. Also identify trial accounts and renewal-risk accounts for targeted follow-up.

Ravi (Eng): One-line RCA: "Automated certificate renewal for the EU onboarding connector did not complete due to a config regression, causing expired certs and webhook authentication failures."

Deploy Bot: deploy triggered by priya-ops:cert-rotate at 09:18 UTC; status: in_progress.

Maya (CS): Good. Also please confirm whether events will be replayed automatically or if customers must reattempt. Elena (from a trial tenant) chimed in reporting 502s. @Elena wondering about next steps for trials that were mid-signup.

Ravi (Eng): Certificate rotated and connector restarted. Deploy status: success. Replays queued; we will attempt automatic replay for missed webhook calls for up to 48 hours of backlog. Prioritizing open signup flows and trials. ETA to finish replay: ~15 minutes.

Priya (Ops): I've added incident tag onboard-cert-expiry; created runbook checklist: rotate cert, restart connector, enable replay, monitor queue drain, confirm tenant success. Also scheduling postmortem within 72 hours.

Liam (CS): Proposed outbound to affected tenants: 

"Hi — we experienced a brief interruption to EU onboarding (approx 09:05–09:20 UTC) caused by an expired certificate on our onboarding connector. We have renewed the certificate, restarted the connector, and are automatically replaying missed onboarding webhook events. No action is needed from you; we will notify you once processing completes. As an apology, well apply a one-week credit and offer a complimentary onboarding session if helpful. Reply to this message to request scheduling."

Maya (CS): Clean and concise. I'll send that to the affected list and tag account owners for renewal-risk customers. Liam, paste the sent copy here after you send.

Deploy Bot: deploy completed by priya-ops:cert-rotate at 09:22 UTC; status: success.

Ravi (Eng): Replay started at 09:23 UTC. Backlog: ~140 events across 10 tenants, expected complete by 09:35 UTC. Will post completion. Also filing PR to add alerts for cert expiry at T-7d and T-1d and to harden renewal cron.

Elena (Customer Success - Tenant): Thanks. Appreciate the automatic replay. Can you confirm if we need to reschedule any webhooks on our side?

Maya (CS): Response for customers: No action required — we will replay events for you. If you continue to see errors after we notify completion, please open a ticket and well investigate immediately.

Priya (Ops): Replay finished at 09:34 UTC; all events processed successfully. Monitoring for any follow-ups for the next hour. Credits and booking link will be added to each affected account page; Ill confirm once done.

Ravi (Eng): Quick next steps for postmortem: root cause deep-dive (why config regressed), add unit/integration tests for renewal flow, add cert-age alerts, and add chaos test for renewal path. Assigned to me; PRs incoming today.

Liam (CS): Sent the outbound to affected list at 09:36 UTC. Tagged renewal-risk accounts and included account owners. Copy pasted here per Maya: 

"[SENT] Hi — we experienced a brief interruption to EU onboarding (09:05 09:20 UTC) due to an expired cert. We've rotated the cert and replayed missed events. No action required; we'll follow up once processing completes. Offer: one-week credit + onboarding session. Reply to schedule."

Maya (CS): Thank you. Closing actions: Liam to confirm send and include thread for record; Priya to confirm credits posted; Ravi to publish postmortem link when ready. Will update renewal tracker if any account flags change. Great job everyone.

Priya (Ops): Credits posted to affected accounts at 10:02 UTC and onboarding session booking link added to account notes.

Ravi (Eng): Postmortem draft created and linked in incident tracker at 14:45 UTC. Will share public-facing summary for CS review before we send a formal RCA to customers.

Maya (CS): Marking thread resolved after CS follow-ups complete. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
